Command `clear; cat > /tmp/b2.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
def tryit(label, f):
    try: print(label, "->", repr(f()).replace("\n"," | "))
    except Exception as e: print(label, "->", type(e).__name__, e)
wide = pd.DataFrame({"units": [5, 7, 9], "returns": [1, 0, 2]}, index=pd.Index(["north", np.nan, "south"], name="region"))
long = wide.stack()
mi = long.index
print("levels", mi.levels[0].tolist(), "codes", mi.codes[0].tolist(), "lexsort_depth", mi._lexsort_depth)
tryit("loc nan", lambda: long.loc[(np.nan, "units")])
tryit("xs", lambda: long.xs(np.nan, level="region"))
tryit("loc north", lambda: long.loc[("north", "units")])
tryit("isin", lambda: mi.isin([(np.nan, "units"), ("south", "units")]))
tryit("groupby", lambda: long.groupby(level="region", dropna=False).sum())
tryit("get_level_values", lambda: mi.get_level_values(0))
tryit("engine values", lambda: mi._engine.values if hasattr(mi._engine,'values') else None)
# from_tuples
ft = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(list(mi), names=mi.names)
print("from_tuples levels", ft.levels[0].tolist(), "codes", ft.codes[0].tolist())
tryit("from_tuples loc", lambda: pd.Series(long.values, index=ft).loc[(np.nan,"units")])
# column variant
cw = pd.DataFrame([[5,7,9]], index=["w1"], columns=pd.MultiIndex.from_arrays([["units"] * 3, ["north", np.nan, "south"]], names=[None, "region"]))
cl = cw.stack(level="region")
print("col variant levels", [l.tolist() for l in cl.index.levels], cl.index.codes)
tryit("col loc", lambda: cl.loc[("w1", np.nan), "units"])
tryit("col loc south", lambda: cl.loc[("w1", "south"), "units"])
# two-level index before stack
w2 = pd.DataFrame({"units": [5, 7, 9], "returns": [1, 0, 2]}, index=pd.MultiIndex.from_arrays([["north", np.nan, "south"], [2024]*3], names=["region","year"]))
l2 = w2.stack()
print("2lvl levels", l2.index.levels[0].tolist(), l2.index.codes[0].tolist())
tryit("2lvl loc", lambda: l2.loc[(np.nan, 2024, "units")])
# melt
m = wide.reset_index().melt(id_vars="region").set_index(["region","variable"])["value"]
print("melt codes", m.index.codes[0].tolist())
tryit("melt loc", lambda: m.loc[(np.nan,"units")])
# verified version
v = pd.MultiIndex(levels=mi.levels, codes=mi.codes, names=mi.names)
print("verified codes", v.codes[0].tolist())
EOF
